article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Texas -- — Aidan McDowell scored 18 points as Sam Houston beat Howard Payne 102-59 on Saturday. McDowell also had six rebounds for the Bearkats (1-1). Matt Dann scored 14 points and added 12 rebounds. Jacobe Coleman had 13 points and shot 5 for 11, including 3 for 6 from beyond the arc. Braylon McGee led the way for the Yellow Jackets with 10 points. Sam Houston took the lead with 19:00 left in the first half and did not trail again. Mahliq Guiseppi–Kitson led his team in scoring with eight points in the first half to help put them up 53-23 at the break. Sam Houston pulled away with a 13-2 run in the second half to extend a 33-point lead to 44 points. McDowell led the way with a team-high 10 second-half points. Up next Sam Houston hosts Pepperdine in its next matchup on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
